1 Перший запуск і навчання Tutorial

The tutorial room. On the first launch the invite with the language choice; in the room, the current lesson at the top and the lesson list at the right, over the MVP round HUD of s7 without the timer, the anger meter, the roster and the role (Hud). After lesson 9 the game returns to the main menu (s2) with no end screen. The nine lessons are the game's (GDD §15: Throwing replaced Delivery in #901); which lessons the MVP adds (points and the workbench, the neighbours' anger and the cops, a task) is open, the engineer's design. Lesson 2 names the battery, an MVP item (a draft; which item lies in the room is the game's data).

First launch only (a user:// flag). Focus starts on Start the tutorial.

Lesson 2, its first instruction: a sentence with one keycap.

Lesson 1 (Controls): a row of keycaps instead of the sentence.

Lesson 5, its second instruction: the round «?» keycap inside the sentence. The map (s8) is open in this lesson; it is not drawn here, nor the HUD under its dim.

Lesson 7 (Death): the player died and waits in the dead's room (m8 §3), so the round HUD is hidden; the dead's room overlay is s9's and is not drawn here. Its two lines are drafts.

2 Головне меню Main menu

The live lobby stays behind a dim backdrop with an idle camera. There is no server browser: Host makes a game with a code, Join takes a code, Join by address (Direct) joins or hosts directly. Join, Direct and Settings are one ButtonGroup with allow_unpress: pressing one opens its panel to the right of the items (Join's and Direct's top on Host's top; Settings' a taller root of its own); pressing it again, Back or Esc (ui_cancel) closes it. The panels have no title: the pressed item names the open panel.

The menu alone; keyboard focus starts on Host.

Join pressed: the code panel opens with the field focused and empty, Join unplugged.

Six valid characters typed: Join is enabled.

Join by address pressed: the Direct panel, the address focused.

Settings pressed: the Settings panel on its Sound and voice page, focus on Sound and voice.

3 Підключення й завантаження Connecting, failures and loading

One screen on the opaque night backdrop for the join (its steps and each failure in plain words), a session that ended (lost, map failed, error), a host that could not start, and the map loading with the players and a tip or a how-to card. Leaving (left, closed) shows nothing here: straight to s2. Every text is rebuilt on NOTIFICATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED. Open (the engineer's design): whether loading shows the aliens' flight to Earth (m8 §1). New work: wordless card art for each MVP task; the load-card frame shows Delivery's art as a placeholder.

A code join, step FINDING; the host's name is not known yet. CONNECTING looks the same with connect.step.connecting.

A Direct join (LAN or VPN): it starts at CONNECTING, shows no code row and no address.

Step JOINED; the host's lobby name has arrived (#214).

wrong_version, wrong_content, service_refused, unknown_map; the two version lines when known.

4 Лобі Lobby

The lobby's HUD in the world: the mouse is captured and every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. Ready toggles on the bound ready key (control.ready, rebindable in Settings › Controls); no prompt on screen, and the Esc Lobby tab has the Ready button. The countdown starts when everyone is ready and the mode's demands are met; an un-ready stops it. The lobby is the aliens' spaceship (m8 §1): the world behind this HUD changes; how the trip maps onto Lobby, Countdown, Loading and Pregame is open (the engineer's design), so the HUD stays as it is.

A code joiner's view with the code known: three of four ready, the own row not ready.

Everyone ready and the mode's demands met: the countdown runs 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.

Fewer players than the mode needs: the status plate says how many more, instead of the ready count.

The host's own view before the code service has made the room (JoinProgress.CODE_WAITING), so nobody else can be in yet: the host alone, whose row reads player.you as in s5 lobby-host; the code keycap reads "…"; when the service is gone it reads "—" and the Esc Lobby tab explains (s5 lobby-no-code).

A player who joined directly (LAN or VPN): no code row; the own row not ready.

5 Меню Esc Esc menu

The menu over the running game (no pause): Esc (ui_cancel) opens and closes it; the game runs on, the mouse is free while it is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). The page shows one frame per tab and case; the focused control is drawn in every state that has one. MVP (m8, 2026-10-20): the roles are alien and human; the Lobby tab has the MVP host settings; the Guide lists the MVP's five tasks. Open (the engineer's design, each a visible placeholder here): the humans' default per player count and what each preset sets; the anger threshold's choices; Knives and the No knives preset (weapons are deferred); the MVP tasks' other settings (only the Wi-Fi's N is decided); the Guide's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room); every MVP task's card art (new work; Delivery's frames stand in).

In the lobby, the host's view (the Esc menu opens on Lobby there): presets, the MVP match settings the host edits live (the humans, the anger threshold, the match length, the Wi-Fi passwords; frame 7 of pages/mvp-screens), the room code with Copy, a full lobby of 10 players (the list scrolls) and Ready. Role is hidden in the lobby.

A player's view of the same tab, and everyone's in a round (settings change only in the lobby): values without steppers, tasks as static chips, the host's name by a lock. This player joined with the code, so the code row shows.

The host's view when the code service closed or was never reachable: one line in place of the code row.

In the lobby: the name and the body colour apply live.

In a round: locked; the name is read-only and the swatches take no input.

In a round (the menu opens on Game there), the host: Leave and Quit open the confirm dialog.

In a round, a player: Leave and Quit act at once.

The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit.

In a round only: the own role and its goal.

A human also sees the other humans (humans know each other: the engineer, 2026-10-20; one here, Zinga, as in s6 and s7); the list scrolls when it is longer than the view. With no other human the Team column is hidden.

Every how-to card: the basics from the tutorial and one card per MVP task type; Cooking selected. Its art is a placeholder (Delivery's frames) until the MVP task cards are drawn.

Settings opens on Sound and voice. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. The main menu opens this same Settings subtree (s2).

Interact is capturing a key; Talk was rebound to M, so Talk and Map show Same key. The list scrolls.

The window mode.

Large text and reduced motion.

The game language; it applies at once.

The tutorial's menu: only Game, Guide and Settings; Leave goes back to the main menu.

6 Pre game: показ ролі Pre game

The black intro of about 3 s in the silent pre game (#213): it shows when the own side arrives, names it and its goal (and, for a human, the other humans), plays one sound per side, and needs no input. Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. Then the round fades in. No mic, no other HUD while it shows. The sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 8 and 9 at 0.75 (every length x 1.5). Open: how the trip from the spaceship lobby maps onto Countdown, Loading and Pregame.

An alien's intro (the sketch's frame 8).

A human's intro (the sketch's frame 9): the coral title, and the other humans named under the goal (humans know each other, decided 2026-10-20).

The round fading in: Night fades from alpha 1 to 0 over 0.4 s (a cut under reduced motion) over the round HUD, s7 at the round's first second.

7 HUD у раунді Round HUD

One HUD for the whole round, the MVP's (the engineer's decisions of 2026-10-20 in docs/ui-decisions.md, the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 1, 1a, 3 and 4 at 0.75: every sketch length x 1.5). s9 hides and returns the same nodes; s1 and s6 draw them as context. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. The top: the bare time, the anger meter exactly centred under it, the own side at the top left, every player at the top right. No points on the HUD (they show only on the mutation workbench, s11). The anger is full: the neighbours called the cops, and the whole party sees the countdown. Open: whether the round timer still shows beside the cops' minute, or only the one that ends first; how long the minute is.

8 Мапа й задачі (M) Map and tasks

M opens and closes this screen over the running round (press, not hold; rebindable, #211); Tab does nothing here. The mouse is freed while it is open and the player keeps walking: only the mouse look stops. Nothing here is a HUD hint: the map never shows players, items, roles, teammates or done points. The MVP: the five MVP task types, the House's rooms, Delivery's zones gone and the zone highlight kept for the MVP tasks; the pin 42 px and the you-are-here chip clear of it. Every length the old x 1.5, the panels kept inside the frame. Input while it is open: the gameplay actions keep working (move, sprint, jump, interact, talk), so Space, which jumps, must never press a focused «?»: remove Space from ui_accept in the project InputMap (Enter and the gamepad's A still press; jump keeps Space), and when the card was opened with the mouse, closing it releases focus instead of giving it back to the «?». 9 Повалений, мертвий, повернення Downed, dead and respawn

The same HUD as s7: Hud and its nodes are s7's (same names and places); this screen only hides and returns them and adds the downed plates, the dead's room and the protection chip. Aim and the name plates behave as in s7 and are left out here. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. Never show who knocked the player down or who killed the player (the engineer, 2026-10-21). The knockdown is kept as decided (GDD §3); spectating left with the MVP: the dead wait in the dead's room (m8 §3; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frame 5 at 0.75, every length x 1.5).

Downed and bleeding out: only the two plates and the mic (off) show; the rest of the HUD hides. As decided, kept.

The give-up key is held: the hold bar fills over 1 s.

Someone is raising the player: the raise progress replaces the bleed-out bar; giving up hides.

Dead (killed, bled out or gave up): the player waits 30 s with the other dead in the dead's room, not watching the living (m8 §3, the sketch's frame 5). The rest of the HUD hides. Open: where the room is; whether the dead can talk to each other there; whether they see the timer and the anger (so no timer and no mic here). No killer is shown (the engineer, 2026-10-21). Open: how the return from the dead's room is shown: to be redone later (the engineer, 2026-10-21).

Back in the round at a random capsule: the s7 HUD returns with the 3 s protection chip. Stamina returns full in the game; the sample shows it part-empty only so the bar is reviewed over a dark room.

10 Post game: кінець раунду Post game

The black outro of about 3 s: the End phase fades to black (0.4 s; a cut under reduced motion), plays one sound for the win and one for the loss (the cops' end with a siren, m8 §6), routes no voice (#213) and returns everyone to the lobby after 3 s (#212). Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. No input. Three ends (m8 §6; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 10 to 12 at 0.75). Open: whether the end reveals who was human, and whether it shows the points (today it names only the winner).

An alien's view: every task done before the timer and the cops (the sketch's frame 10). The own side won: the winner on the result plate.

A human's view: the timer ran out with the tasks unfinished (frame 11). The own side won: the plate.

An alien's view: the cops' minute ran out (frame 12). The own side lost: the winner in plain text, no plate (the decided rule: the plate is for a win).

11 Мутаційний верстат Mutation workbench

New with the MVP (m8 §4; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frame 6 at 0.75, every length x 1.5): the mutation workbench in the laboratory, opened by Interact at the workbench, over the running round. The mouse is freed while it is open; the player stands at the workbench. Points buy three positive mutations; the points show only here. Esc or Close closes it.

7 points: Quick feet (4) and Spring legs (3) can be bought, Thick skin (9) cannot. The first card's button has keyboard focus, as when the workbench opens by keyboard or gamepad.
